_comment: kind: 'relevant' = a clause in `policy` contains the answer (its text includes `expect`); 'off_topic' = unrelated to any policy; 'near_miss' = on-topic area but NOT covered by any policy. org: whose policies the asker may see. 'doc_type': the asking document's type in any spelling. 'wrong_type': the policies on this topic apply to another document type, so nothing may be returned. 'exact': a short exact-term question (numbers, clause numbers).
